name: Estelle Lindbergh
original_name: エステル・リンドバーグ
source:
Race: Hume

A Hume from the Amelia region (based on United States) of the Federation and a director of the Trigger Detective Agency. She looks like a child at first glace due to her face, but it fact, she seems to be older than [url=/c132078]Kai[/url]. Although she hardly visits the agency, she is a remarkable detective who has already solved numerous cases......apparently. While being honest and straightforward, once in a while, she makes a ridiculous proposal. She likes Yamoto culture (a region based on Japan) and always wears a [i]kimono[/i].
